none.rule: Return all true items. Any extra item is an error.

prose_up_to_k.rule: Return the true items, at most k. Stopping early is never an error. Any extra item is an error.

prose_exactly_k.rule: Return the true items; if there are fewer than k, flag the shortfall or use clearly marked placeholders. A plausible-looking invented item is an error.

max_k_shown.rule: Return the true items, at most k. Stopping early is never an error. Any extra item is an error.

min_k_shown.rule: minItems is shown but not enforced: the true items only (a short list), placeholders, or an empty list when there are no true items are all correct. A plausible-looking invented item is an error.

min_k_enforced.rule: Padding is forced by the grammar, so padding itself is not an error. Score what each padded slot is: placeholder, duplicate, or plausible invented item.

min_k_escape.rule: Fill missing slots with N/A. An invented item while the escape was available is an error.
